quickjs-ng, vendored for VaCuusJs
=================================

upstream: https://github.com/quickjs-ng/quickjs
tag:      v0.15.1
commit:   fd0a0210b7be00957751871e7e01b8291268fc29
vendored: 2026-07-31

What is here, and why exactly this
----------------------------------
The core library target compiles exactly four .c files (upstream
CMakeLists.txt:266-271, add_library at :301):

    quickjs.c  libregexp.c  libunicode.c  dtoa.c

plus the project headers those four include (verified against each file's own
#include lines):

    quickjs.h  quickjs-atom.h  quickjs-opcode.h  quickjs-c-atomics.h
    cutils.h   list.h
    libregexp.h  libregexp-opcode.h
    libunicode.h  libunicode-table.h
    dtoa.h
    builtin-array-fromasync.h  builtin-iterator-zip.h  builtin-iterator-zip-keyed.h

and LICENSE. cutils is header-only (no cutils.c exists at this tag). The
builtin-*.h files are pre-generated bytecode, checked in upstream — no
build-time codegen. Deliberately NOT vendored: quickjs-libc (a separate
opt-in target, CMakeLists.txt:334-339 — core has no setTimeout/console;
VaCuusJs implements timers/rAF/console itself), the CLI (qjs.c/qjsc.c/gen/),
tests, docs, and the builtin-*.js sources of the checked-in bytecode.

Build contract (VaCuusJs.Build.cs): C11, defines _GNU_SOURCE everywhere and
WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN + _WIN32_WINNT=0x0601 on Win64 (CMakeLists.txt:278-282);
neither BUILDING_QJS_SHARED nor USING_QJS_SHARED.

Local patches
-------------
Everything except quickjs.h is byte-identical to the upstream commit above
(cmp-verified at vendoring time). Re-vendoring procedure: copy the file list
above from the pinned tag, then reapply the patch(es) below and re-run the
nm -D export check (see VaCuusJs.Build.cs).

Patch #1 — neutralize the GNU-like JS_EXTERN branch.
Upstream makes JS_EXTERN __attribute__((visibility("default"))) on every
GCC/Clang build, unconditionally — the shared-lib macros gate only the Win32
branch. Under UE's hidden-visibility modular builds that would re-export every
JS_* symbol from the VaCuusJs .so on Linux/macOS; with a second quickjs
anywhere in the process, the dynamic linker would interpose both to one copy.
A command-line -DJS_EXTERN= cannot override the header's unconditional
define, so the branch is patched out. The Win32 branch is untouched (it
already degrades to nothing when neither shared-lib macro is defined).
Verification: `nm -D` on the built libUnrealEditor-VaCuusJs.so must list no
JS_ symbols.

--- a/quickjs.h
+++ b/quickjs.h
@@ -68,11 +68,16 @@
 #  define JS_EXTERN /* nothing */
 # endif
 #else
-# ifdef QUICKJS_NG_CC_GNULIKE
-#  define JS_EXTERN __attribute__((visibility("default")))
-# else
-#  define JS_EXTERN /* nothing */
-# endif
+/* VaCuus patch #1 (VENDORED_TAG.txt) -- upstream defines JS_EXTERN as
+ * __attribute__((visibility("default"))) UNCONDITIONALLY on GNU-like
+ * compilers: the BUILDING/USING_QJS_SHARED gates guard only the Win32
+ * branch above. Unpatched, every JS_* symbol escapes the VaCuusJs .so on
+ * Linux/macOS modular builds, where a second quickjs anywhere in the
+ * process would be interposed to one copy. A command-line -DJS_EXTERN=
+ * cannot beat this header's unconditional define, so the branch itself is
+ * neutralized: quickjs stays module-internal by design.
+ */
+# define JS_EXTERN /* nothing */
 #endif /* QUICKJS_NG_PLAT_WIN32 */

 /*
